card: This PR refactors invalid block handling by relocating block failure flag updates, best header recalculations, and logging from InvalidChainFound into InvalidBlockFound and InvalidateBlock. When ActivateBestChain encountered an invalid block, it previously performed duplicate block index traversals and emitted duplicate log messages by invoking the failure routines twice. The change eliminates the redundant iterations and renames the remaining helper to UpdateBestInvalid. The author cites review discussions in PR 31405 and PR 31533 highlighting this repeated work.
changed_since_previous: Added a functional test in test/functional/rpc_invalidateblock.py verifying that invalidating headers that were never connected to the active chain properly marks descendant headers invalid and resets the best header.
evidence: PR description cites review discussions in PR #31405 (review comment r2135717500) and PR #31533 (review comment r2607189790) identifying repeated work in InvalidateBlock and ActivateBestChain.
problem: When ActivateBestChain encounters an invalid block, it calls InvalidBlockFound on the failed block and then called InvalidChainFound on the chain candidate. Because InvalidChainFound ran SetBlockFailureFlags and RecalculateBestHeader and logged chain state, these block index tree traversals and log messages were executed twice in immediate succession.

risk.why: A mistake in propagating block failure flags or recalculating the best header could leave nodes tracking an invalid chain tip or misrepresenting chain validity.

summary: Refactors invalid block handling in validation by moving block failure flag propagation, best header recalculation, and fork warning checks out of InvalidChainFound into InvalidBlockFound and InvalidateBlock. In ActivateBestChain, this avoids redundant loops over the block index and duplicated log entries previously triggered by running the full failure sequence twice. Renames the residual InvalidChainFound function to UpdateBestInvalid to reflect its narrowed role of tracking the invalid block with the most work.
